10 And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven. (Luke 12:10 KJV)

Blasphemy against the Holy Ghost is more than sin, as it is a rebellion against God, and is a very serious offence.  When a person is born again (Romans 10:9-10), they make Jesus their Lord as well as their Savior, and therefore must follow His commands given through the Holy Ghost.  We must always obey Jesus to assure our eternal salvation (Hebrews 5:9).  This statement by Jesus is also recorded in Matthew 12:31-32 and Mark 3:28-29, and would not have been said by Jesus unless it is very important.  To better understand this, and for a current occasion, please visit our web site page “New Revelations” so you can understand it more completely.

Blasphemy can be just making your mind up that you will not do what the Holy Spirit is telling you too, thereby rebelling against Him.  It also can be blaming God for the things that the devil does, and many are teaching that God controls everything, therefore He is responsible for the works done by the devil.  As you will see from the “New Revelations” given to me, it can cause a born again Christian to be sent to hell, as well as causing God’s judgment to come upon you.  For this reason, all Christians need to be very careful to never refuse to do what the Holy Ghost tells us to do, as if you are in rebellion against Him, you will not go to heaven, even if you have been born again and full of the Holy Ghost.  Wow!  Thank you Jesus for this revelation.
